title: Tensor equation for the canonical single/pullback comparison
statement: Let B be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with additive tensor and functorial flat resolutions. Let v:X′→X be a scheme morphism whose exact inverse image U preserves flat objects. Let L,M be B-valued sheaves on X with L flat. Write S,S′ for degree-zero inclusion, D for the derived inverse image, γ for exactly singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso.hom, μ for singleFunctorObjTensorIso.hom, δU for ordinary oplax tensor comparison, and δD for leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison. Then D(μ(L,M));γ(L tensor M);S′(δU(L,M))=δD(SL,SM);(γ(L) tensor γ(M));μ(UL,UM). Flatness of UL follows from that of L. No arbitrary pairing square or comparison maps to other sheaves occur; M need not be flat. The notions are those of [def-kun-derived-tensor], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. Exact inverse image is that of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact].

source.place: Tags 06YQ (lemma-bounded-flat-K-flat) and 06YU (definition-derived-tor and signed symmetry immediately following it); degree-zero specialization of the canonical tensor localization. For inverse image: lemma-pullback-tensor-product, and the upstream derived tensor/counit equation in Derived.UpperStarMonoidal.Comparison.

proof.text: Use the proved homotopy single tensor square, the proved canonical single/pullback counit identity, and the proved homotopy factorization of the source and target flat single tensorators. Naturality of the single/Qh comparison gives the counit identity after the ordinary oplax comparison as well. A categorical transport calculation moves the canonical isomorphisms through the derived tensor comparison, uses Qh tensorator naturality and the derived tensor/counit square, and reduces the desired equality to the homotopy single tensor square. The calculation cancels the single/Qh isomorphisms, retaining exactly the prescribed single/pullback maps.

theorem singleFunctorObjTensorIso_pullback
    {X' : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}} (v : X' ⟶ X)
    [(upperStar B v).PreservesFlat]
    (L M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B) (hL : ObjectProperty.flat L) :
    (upperStar B v).leftDerivedFunctor.map (singleFunctorObjTensorIso L M hL).hom ≫
      (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B v).hom.app (L ⊗ M) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map
        (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (upperStar B v) L M) =
    ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison B v).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L)).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≫
      ((singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B v).hom.app L ⊗ₘ
        (singleFunctorCompLeftDerivedUpperStarIso B v).hom.app M) ≫
      (singleFunctorObjTensorIso ((upperStar B v).obj L) ((upperStar B v).obj M)
        (Functor.PreservesFlat.flat_obj hL)).hom
